text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: SLO breach detected — p99 streaming latency > 3.0s for /v1/stream (us-west-2) over last 5m. Pager: @sre-ana. Dash: https://dash.redwood/alerts/281345 :rotating_light:
sre-ana: taking it. pulling dashboards now. any known deploys? which model variants are serving in us-west?
eng-jake: I pushed a quantized rollout to us-west last night (gen-qlat-v2). seeing spike aligned with kvcache miss rate increase and more kv-evictions on the streaming pool. p95 up ~600ms, p99 >3s. dash: https://dash.redwood/streams/us-west
ml-erin: that rollout included a new kernel optimization for attention mem tradeoffs — maybe introduced eviction pressure. can we fallback to unquantized model?
sre-ana: good call. initiating temporary routing change to route 90% -> gen-base-v1, 10% to gen-qlat-v2. applying via routing service now: 
```
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/stream --region us-west-2 --weights gen-base-v1=90,gen-qlat-v2=10
```
eng-jake: started rolling restart of inference-nodes in pool gw-stream-03 to clear kvcache fragmentation. restarting one at a time. logs show repeated `kv_cache_eviction: threshold` on gw-stream-03-7.
support-liam: no large customer pages yet, but saw 3 customers with intermittent streaming timeouts and increased reconnects. flagging for possible SLA impact. :eyes:
eng-jake: after reroute and first node restart p99 dropped on that node from ~5.4s -> 1.8s, overall p99 trending down but still noisy.
sre-ana: if no improvement in 10m I'll escalate to eng-platform for a config rollback and consider disabling batching window optimizations for streaming. PD escalation ready: ENG-PLATFORM oncall.
product-sam: heads-up — this could touch Dedicated customers using reserved streaming capacity. prepping comms in case we see sustained degradation.
ml-erin: can we also temporarily disable the new attention kernel on the quantized variant as a failing fast measure? that would let us keep qlat but without the new kernel behavior.
sre-ana: noted. eng-jake can you toggle kernel flag in canary then re-evaluate?
eng-jake: doing: `redis set /flags/qlat_attention_opt false --env us-west-2` then will monitor for 30s.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigations applied (reroute + node restarts). p99 (region us-west-2) improved from 5.2s -> 2.0s in last 5m. Current state: Mitigating. Next: await 10m stability window then rollback quantized rollout if still unstable.
sre-ana: assigning follow-ups: eng-jake (root cause check & kernel toggle validation), ml-erin (model rollback plan), support-liam (customer contact list), product-sam (comms draft). I'll keep PD escalation on standby.
eng-jake: noted, will paste logs and cpu/mem/kvcache traces in this thread momentarily.
support-liam: adding impacted customer list: cust-acme, cust-zenstack (streaming pods reconnects), cust-halo (low rate but high qps sessions).
sre-ana: thanks — if p99 stays >2.5s after 10m we escalate. posting status to #oncall-handoff and will create incident ticket for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
